response.sql: SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(replacement_cost / NULLIF(rental_rate, 0)) AS avg_cost_to_rate_ratio FROM film WHERE length >= 112;

assumptions.assumption: Films with NULL length are excluded, since NULL >= 112 is not true. The filter is inclusive of 112.
A rental_rate of 0 would give a missing ratio, and NULLIF makes that explicit. Verified rental_rate values are only 0.99, 2.99 and 4.99, so this never applies in practice.
